name: HORI
name_origin: 彫り — Japanese for 'the carving', the craft of the tattoo artist
mascot: koi (鯉) — perseverance, transformation, the koi that leaps the Dragon Gate becomes a dragon
mission: To build a local-first agent runtime with a safety spine that helps latent builders solve problems at the speed of intent, not the speed of AI. HORI is not an 'AI Operating System' — it is narrower and more honest: a runtime that carves precise, permanent marks while keeping the LLM untrusted and the architecture trusted.
tagline: Solve problems at the speed of intent, not the speed of AI.
audience: Latent builders — people with the potential to build things who need a system that helps them realize it.
workflow: Converse first, build second. The system refuses to code until a shared design concept is reached, then executes in strict red/green/refactor loops.

principles.name: Low Entropy Protocol (LEP)
principles.description: Prioritize the preservation of intent integrity and information fidelity across all layers of the system.

principles.name: Local-First Intelligence
principles.description: Ensure core reasoning and sensitive data processing happen locally to maximize privacy, speed, and autonomy. The private alternative to frontier paid-trap ecosystems.

principles.name: Hybrid Intelligence
principles.description: Seamlessly orchestrate between local edge models and powerful cloud models to optimize for both latency and reasoning depth.

principles.name: Intentional Friction
principles.description: Use agentic red-teaming to challenge deviations from the core mission, ensuring long-term alignment. Converse first, build second.

principles.name: Self-Healing Autonomy
principles.description: Design the system to proactively monitor, diagnose, and recover from failures without human intervention. The koi persists through the current.

principles.name: Simplicity as Security
principles.description: More rules create more rulebreakers. Each safety layer must justify itself against the complexity it adds. The irreducible minimum is the spine.
